title: Spire® 200 LED Beacon
subtitle: Full-size LED beacon, 12/24V, multiple flash patterns, heavy-duty mount options.
description: The Federal Signal Spire® 200 LED Beacon is a full-size LED beacon delivering high-output 360° warning visibility for utility, municipal, and heavy-duty service fleets. Operating on 12/24 Vdc with multiple selectable flash patterns, it supports heavy-duty permanent, pipe, and magnetic mount options for demanding work-truck applications.
summary_bullets: High-output LED beacon with NightSpire® technology
Available in tall and short dome profiles

features: Heavy-duty permanent, pipe, and magnetic mount options
benefits: Full-size housing maximizes visibility on heavy-duty and municipal fleets
Heavy-duty mount options withstand demanding work-truck duty cycles
applications: Heavy-duty utility and municipal service trucks
Snow plows and winter maintenance fleets
